recommendations.regimenLabel: Non-pharmacological — education, triggers, salt/fluid, counter-pressure manoeuvres
steps: Reassure once cardiac causes excluded; explain mechanism.
Avoid triggers; ensure hydration and adequate salt intake.
Teach physical counter-pressure manoeuvres (leg crossing, hand grip) at prodrome.
Review/stop hypotensive drugs; treat orthostatic component (compression, slow rising).
ECG ± monitoring to rule out arrhythmia; refer cardiology if exertional/red-flag features.
recommendations.notes: Management is non-pharmacological. The approved prose prescribes no drug (only review/stop hypotensive medication); therefore no drugRefs are structured. Second-line pharmacotherapy for recurrent refractory reflex syncope (e.g. midodrine or fludrocortisone) is not mentioned in this guidance and has not been added.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Syncope
ESC Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Syncope

decision.label: Non-pharmacological; cardiology only if red flags

confirm: Transient LOC with prodrome (warmth, nausea, greying vision), rapid full recovery, typical triggers; orthostatic drop or reflex pattern. Exclude cardiac/structural cause.
